title: task_detail
description: What ot task show prints with --json: the task and its live reminders as GET /api/v1/reminders returns them, location reminders (kind arrive or leave, radius_m in metres, no fire_at) included (OpenSpec location-reminders).

fire_at.description: Unix ms; always null for arrive and leave

radius_m.description: metres, 100 to 5000, only for arrive and leave
